name: Low-temperature microthermometry of CO2-rich mineral inclusions
plain_name: Watch trapped fluid change phase in rock
description: Earth-science phase-change microscopy of trapped fluids,with a mineral wafer rather than a generic sensor puck.
keywords: Watch trapped fluid change phase in rock

requirements.rationale: Selected calibrated low-temperature window -56.6 to0 C,not the unrelated high-temperature homogenization procedure.
Fluid inclusions are observed through a doubly polished mineral wafer.

missing_information: The publication also performs higher-temperature work; this profile deliberately covers only its calibrated low-temperature leg.
A manufacturer's stability figure does not independently prove the publication's calibration uncertainty; calibration must be supplied by the lab.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
